name: Ebon Crypt (place)
summary: The Ebon Crypt is a tomb west of Cath Bedraud in Glenumbra containing Bloodthorn cultists. The dungeon consists of a simple loop, with the boss, a bone colossus called The Ebon Lord, in the large chamber at the far end. Take the northern passageway to activate the delve's skyshard. The note Bloodthorn Orders: Ebon Crypt lies at the entrance and in the hall just south of the boss chamber. Rats and torchbugs are found in numbers within.
notes: Reading the eponymous letter will mark Ebon Crypt on your map.
